claims.evidence: The witness confirms the presence of a standing hair dryer with a brand label and control knobs.

risks.risk: The heating element or fan motor may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the dryer switched on and blowing air.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be frayed, damaged, or missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full length of the power cord and the plug.

risks.risk: The base of the stand may be cracked or unstable.
risks.proof: A photo showing the complete base of the stand on the floor.
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged or incomplete unit

proof_requests: Video of the hair dryer in operation showing the fan and heat functions.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
Photo of the full base of the stand.
Clarification on whether the mannequin head is included.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and model. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit until operational proof is provided.
